wholePhysicalScope: The named native OpenStreetMap multipolygon fixes the mosque and court. The 1912 measured plan records the orthogonal prayer room, supporting half-domes, porch and roofline. The Istanbul survey describes a 12 m main interior dome.
lodDetails: Four detail levels carry the main dome, minaret and corridor. Nearer levels resolve masonry windows and the portico.
limitations: Core proportions follow Gurlitt’s measured section and the mapped standing complex. The present minaret height, roof seams, gallery details and windows are estimated from documented architecture.
The fountain is a simplified interpretation of the covered courtyard structure. Separate streetside mausoleum, school and monuments are outside the assembled mosque and madrasa enclosure.
Ornamental stone, lead flashing, porch tiles and interior details are simplified.
